newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's says may raise Asahi Breweries debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may raise Asahi Breweries debt rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday that it had placed Asahi Breweries Ltd's long-term debt rating under review for possible upgrade.
Moody's said in a statement that it had also placed Asahi unit Asahi Beer International Finance BV's long-term debt rating under review for possible upgrading.
The ratings for the two companies' long-term debts are both Ba2, Moody's said.
The review will focus on Asahi's ability to maintain or to further improve its market position and favourable operating performance in a challenging market environment, Moody's said.
It will also examine the potential burden from Asahi's investment activities and how successfully it will be able to improve its balance sheet quality and debt protection measurements, Moody's said.
